name: Wave Lab
desc: A vibrating-string lab: tension, density, pluck position and damping drive the standing-wave modes, with harmonic frequencies and the pluck-point node rule shown live.
controls: Tension, density, pluck-position and damping sliders, four presets (guitar/violin/bass/harp), pluck button, modes toggle, click-to-set-pluck; keys 1–4 load presets, Space plucks
creator: Original build (Dragon Gaming Assets)
